title: MicroSim Library Routing Table
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI Agent Skills
MicroSim Generator
Visualization Library Routing
Meta-Skills
Trigger Keywords
description: Left-to-right flowchart of an incoming request entering the MicroSim Generator meta-skill and fanning out to six visualization libraries (p5.js, Chart.js, vis-network, vis-timeline, Leaflet, Mermaid), each arrow labeled with trigger keywords. The reader is given seven requests and applies the routing table by clicking the library each one should be routed to, with immediate feedback and one deliberately ambiguous request.

educational.topic: Routing a MicroSim request to a visualization library by trigger keywords
learningObjectives: Demonstrate how a request's keywords route to one of several visualization libraries.
Identify the trigger keyword in a request that decides its route.
Explain why a request that matches two routes equally needs a clarifying question.
prerequisites: Knows what a meta-skill and a trigger keyword table are
Has seen at least one MicroSim built with p5.js

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: The learner applies the routing table to seven requests, predicts the route, and receives feedback naming the keywords that matched
keyQuestions: Which word in the request describes the shape of the data?
What should the generator do when two routes match equally?
commonMisconceptions: The generator routes on the subject of the lesson rather than on the kind of data
The word graph always means a chart
assessmentOpportunities: Route seven requests and name the deciding keyword for each
Write a new request for a chosen library and have a partner route it
